name: GAMMA-400
summary: GAMMA-400 is a Russian-led space gamma-ray development project for a proposed space orbit; orbital design and launch scheduling require mission updates. Question-marked years in old catalogs are not actual launch dates.
detection_principle: Gamma-ray pair conversion, tracking and deep calorimetry improve energy and directional resolution to search for narrow lines and spectral structure toward targets including the Galactic center.

results.summary: Forecasts Galactic-center two-photon annihilation lines, decay lines and ALP sensitivity. Results depend on density profiles and background models; there are no measured exclusions.

science_scope: Searches cosmic gamma-ray, antiparticle or neutrino spectra, directions and fluxes for indirect signatures of dark-matter annihilation, decay or related new physics. Conventional astrophysical sources and propagation can produce similar signals, requiring background modeling; design sensitivity is not a measured limit or discovery.
